subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should a channel runtime expose a generic ChannelAccountSnapshot.processRestartRequired contract that lets the health monitor request supervised gateway replacement, or must this recovery request remain Telegram-owned?
rationale: Both implementations can preserve the demonstrated recovery and safety invariants, but choosing the permanent public channel/plugin contract is an ownership and product-boundary decision that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the additive snapshot field and cross-channel monitor policy, with the existing documentation, durable budget, and supervised-only safeguards.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the public snapshot field with a narrow injected restart-request path owned by Telegram while retaining the same monitor and restart protections.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive snapshot field and cross-channel monitor policy, with the existing documentation, durable budget, and supervised-only safeguards.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal ties this person to the Telegram polling and spool lifecycle whose recovery contract is being decided.
